title: LABrador IndicationThesis (snake_case v1.0.0)
description: Canonical public request shared by hypothesis, orchestration, clinical, tractability, and comparison stations for one computable indication thesis. The wire format is snake_case. NOTHING is inferred to fill an absent field: an unsupplied uniprot_accession remains absent and a null/absent as_of_date means evidence as of today. Clinical invocation: `bun run simulate <request.json> --out <result.json>`. The cache key a consumer may rely on is (id, as_of_date).

id.description: Caller-chosen stable identifier for this thesis; used for caching and cross-referencing runs.

modality.description: Wide on purpose — upstream must never misdescribe an antibody as a small molecule to satisfy a downstream consumer.

symbol.description: Gene symbol. The tractability station keys on uniprot_accession instead — supply it when known.

uniprot_accession.description: The cross-station join key (e.g. IRAK4 -> Q9NWZ3). Must be the RESOLVED accession when present — resolution is the upstream station's job, never this station's.

name.description: The indication as a ClinicalTrials.gov-searchable condition name — this string drives every registry query.

biomarker_population.description: The population the trial would actually enrol. prevalence_in_disease is the single most consequential number this station consumes; prefer SOURCED values (see fixtures/epi/ for the cited-record pattern) over analyst assumptions, and keep the marker string consistent with the epi record's case definition — a sourced number under a mismatched definition is a silent error.

expected_effect_size.description: Standardised effect size (Cohen's d) the thesis predicts. When present it drives powering; the output reports the basis either way, and the indication's phase-3 precedent median floors the result.

mechanism.description: Free-text causal story: target -> pathway -> cell type -> phenotype.

mechanism_hypothesis.description: Structural mechanism class for the tractability station (its chain selection is load-bearing on this). British spelling, one underscore. Absent/null is equivalent to `unknown`. Never derived by this station.

evidence.description: Traceable claims. `source` must be a real identifier (NCT id, PMID, DOI, database accession) — unsourced claims are unrepresentable by design. `no_effect` is a null result, distinct from evidence-against; consumers weighing only supports/contradicts must treat it as neutral, never as contradicts.

uncertainty.description: 0 = fully determined, 1 = pure speculation. Set by upstream stations.

as_of_date.description: Temporal cutoff for retrieval, ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD). When set, every registry fact used must predate it, so a hindcast cannot see evidence that did not yet exist. Null means 'as of today'. The one documented open channel: the model-based eligibility read cannot have its knowledge sealed to the cutoff.
